Syswatch 01 clock font comparison

Generated by scripts/generate-clock-font.mjs. Departure Mono 1.500 by Helena Zhang (SIL Open Font License 1.1, https://github.com/rektdeckard/departure-mono) is the production clock font, locked at 99 px. It sets the main clock numerals, the colon and AM/PM only. The date, event text, heart rate, battery and weather are Share Tech Mono 1.003. All values are sample content.

The clock is drawn from the unmodified font outlines at whole multiples of 11 px, with one uniform scale, whole-pixel glyph origins and anti-aliasing off. Tracking only moves glyphs closer together; the glyphs themselves are untouched. AM/PM is 22 px. The clock area of the HUD frame is 300 px wide.

88 px · 8× the 11 px design size

Each design pixel is a 8×8 block. Digits are 40 px wide and 64 px tall on a 56 px advance.

99 px · 9× the 11 px design size

Each design pixel is a 9×9 block. Digits are 45 px wide and 72 px tall on a 63 px advance.

Each design pixel is a 10×10 block. Digits are 50 px wide and 80 px tall on a 70 px advance.
